decisions.statement: The folder is named the plural one or more page types gather their pages under.
A folder named no page type's plural is refused before anything else is read.
Every page here is of one of those page types or of a page type extending one.
The folder above holds a page of its own.
A folder above holding no page is refused.
Every page here names the page above.
The page above is named by its page type and slug together.
The page above answering with two addresses is held by the one the pages here name.
A page sits here as a file of its own or in a folder of its own.
A file beside a page that page states nowhere is refused.
A file that is neither a page nor a file beside one is refused.
A folder gathering no page at all is refused.
The files a page in a folder of its own holds are judged where that page is.
A page in a folder of its own names the page above as a page sitting here does.
A page is read for what it names by the path the folder holding it answers with.

definition: the shape of a folder gathering under a plural the pages naming the page above
